attributes.name: Skulgrym
attributes.powers:
Skulgrym is immune to the Electricity and Poison traits. If you are the only character at your location, the difficulty of checks to defeat Skulgrym is increased by 4.

Before you act, succeed at a Constitution or Fortitude 9 check or bury a card.

Increase the damage dealt by Skulgrym by your number of buried cards.
